npc.name: Elder Rowan
npc.dialogue: Elder Rowan keeps one hand on his cane and the other pointed toward trouble.

npc.name: Well Keeper Mara
npc.dialogue: Mara knows every bucket, rumor, and hidden crack in the old square.

dialogue_lines.line: The well has moods. Today it sounds like rain remembered from very far away.
If you travel north, mind the quiet patches. Forests only go silent when they are listening.
I keep three buckets ready: one for thirst, one for fire, and one for strange heroes.

npc.name: Squire Tovin
npc.dialogue: Tovin waits near the hearth with a strapped shield, a nervous grin, and more courage than polish.

npc.name: Apprentice Mira
npc.dialogue: Mira keeps a spellbook tucked under one arm and watches the inn door as if it might ask a question.

npc.name: Trailhand Pip
npc.dialogue: Pip leans beside the common-room stairs, already mapping exits, shadows, and likely snack routes.
npc.recruit_missing_item_text: Pip pats every pocket, then tries not to look worried. He will not leave the inn without his lucky button.

npc.name: Steward Elowen
npc.dialogue: Steward Elowen carries a green lantern wrapped in cloth, as if even hope needs shade.

npc.name: Watch Captain Sera
npc.dialogue: Sera's cloak is patched, but her watch badge is polished bright.

npc.name: Archivist Lyra
npc.dialogue: Archivist Lyra stands beneath a mobile of silver moons and annotated keys.

npc.name: Keeper Nox
npc.dialogue: Nox has ink on every finger and a theory for every disaster.

npc.name: Relic-Seer Maelis
npc.dialogue: Maelis listens to the old stones as if they are whispering just under the floor.

npc.name: Ranger Ilethe
npc.dialogue: Ilethe carries thorn scratches like a map and refuses to call any forest cursed until she has walked it twice.

npc.name: Foreman Borin
npc.dialogue: Borin's beard is singed at three different lengths, which he calls professional evidence.

npc.name: Astronomer Sahir
npc.dialogue: Sahir keeps one eye on the sky and one on the sand, trusting neither completely.

npc.name: Curator Vesper
npc.dialogue: Vesper speaks softly because the archive repeats loud words back with commentary.

npc.name: Scout Naeve
npc.dialogue: Naeve has seen the inside of the Starless Citadel and smiles like someone who escaped by arguing with fate.

npc.name: Pilgrim Jory
npc.dialogue: Jory counts blessings on one hand and escape routes on the other.

dialogue_lines.line: Every relic road has a different weather. That is how you know the old magic is showing off.
I came to see a miracle. If I find three practical meals instead, I will call it even.
The final gate hums at night. I do not hum back. That is how it starts.
